name: instrument-picker
zh_caption: 设备机架的乐器入口与预设行
en_caption: Instrument entry and preset row in the device rack

name: synth-device-params
zh_caption: 合成器九参数与设备卡读数
en_caption: Synth nine parameters and device-card readout

name: factory-preset-picker
zh_caption: 底部设备机架的预设入口打开，六个合成器预设可见，当前轨为 MIDI 合成器轨。
en_caption: The preset entry in the bottom device rack is open, all six synth presets are visible, and the current track is a MIDI synth track.
zh_steps: 选中一条 MIDI 轨，按 F9 打开设备机架，点乐器栏的预设入口，逐个试听六个预设。
en_steps: Select a MIDI track, press F9 to open the device rack, click the instrument row's preset entry, and audition all six presets.

name: sample-library-picker
zh_caption: 音源管理面板打开，已安装音源列表可见，某条目旁有载入当前轨的入口，当前轨为 MIDI 轨。
en_caption: The instrument manager is open, installed instruments are listed, an entry has a load-to-current-track action, and the current track is MIDI.
zh_steps: 选中一条 MIDI 轨，按 F9 打开设备机架，点空态“+ 加载 SFZ”，在音源管理里选一个已安装条目，载入当前轨。
en_steps: Select a MIDI track, press F9 to open the device rack, click the empty-state "+ Load SFZ", choose an installed item in the instrument manager, and load it onto the current track.

name: sfz-load-report
zh_caption: 装载回执展开，能看到 regions 数量、样本来源与 probe 的帧数/能量；若失败则能看到 missing 或 include 列表。
en_caption: The load receipt is expanded, showing the region count, sample source, and the probe's frame count and energy; on failure, a missing or include list is visible.
zh_steps: 装载一份 SFZ 后查看模块回执；若 probe 帧数为 0，换一个落在音区内的探测音再试。
en_steps: Load an SFZ and inspect the module receipt; if the probe frame count is 0, try a note inside the covered range.

name: instrument-rack-synth-presets
zh_caption: 设备机架乐器入口打开，只显示当前合成器预设与 SFZ 音源，没有物理建模分类或参数面板。
en_caption: The device-rack instrument entry is open; only current synth presets and SFZ sources are listed, with no physical-modeling category or parameter panel.
zh_steps: 选中一条 MIDI 轨，按 F9 打开设备机架，点乐器入口，确认列表里没有 String/Beam/Membrane/Plate 物理建模乐器。
en_steps: Select a MIDI track, press F9 to open the device rack, click the instrument entry, and confirm that String/Beam/Membrane/Plate physical-modeling instruments are absent.

name: drum-clip-piano-roll
zh_caption: 生成的鼓型片段在钢琴卷帘里显示为一列 MIDI 音符，可按键位与力度继续编辑。
en_caption: The generated drum clip appears as a column of MIDI notes in the piano roll, editable by key and velocity.
zh_steps: 双击生成的鼓型片段打开钢琴卷帘，确认可以改音符位置/力度；这里改的是片段，不是鼓机参数。
en_steps: Double-click the generated drum clip to open the piano roll; confirm notes and velocities can be edited; this edits the clip, not the drum-machine parameters.

name: drum-gen-dialog
zh_caption: “鼓机生成”对话框打开：左列风格列表，右列复杂度/强度/摇摆/小节数/种子/填充开关，底部目标轨说明与“生成”按钮。
en_caption: The "Drum Generation" dialog is open: style list on the left, complexity/intensity/swing/bars/seed/fill on the right, target-track line and "Generate" button at the bottom.
zh_steps: 打开“编辑 → 鼓机生成 (Drums)...”，选一个风格，确认摇摆框被播种为该风格定值，再点“生成”。
en_steps: Open "Edit → Drum Generation (Drums)...", choose a style, confirm the swing field is seeded with that style's value, then click "Generate".

name: drum-track-device-rack
zh_caption: 生成后的电子鼓轨在设备机架里显示合成鼓机、通道条、混响与可选延迟；参数是只读读数。
en_caption: The generated electronic drum track in the device rack shows the synth drum machine, channel strip, reverb, and optional delay; parameters are read-only.
zh_steps: 选中生成的鼓轨，按 F9 打开设备机架，确认音源是 \texttt{Yeban Drum Kit (Synth)}，效果卡按生成顺序排列。
en_steps: Select the generated drum track, press F9 to open the device rack, confirm the source is \texttt{Yeban Drum Kit (Synth)}, and that effect cards follow the generation order.

name: device-rack-plugin-instrument
zh_caption: 设备机架里当前轨的设备卡显示插件乐器名称与延迟读数，没有插件参数面板。
en_caption: The current track's device card in the device rack shows the plugin instrument name and latency readout; there is no plugin parameter panel.
zh_steps: 装载成功后按 F9 打开设备机架，确认设备卡只显示插件名/延迟，没有可拧的参数；回到插件面板确认没有常驻编辑器。
en_steps: After a successful load, press F9 to open the device rack; confirm the card shows only plugin name/latency with no knobs; return to the plugin panel and confirm there is no resident editor.

name: plugin-panel-load
zh_caption: 面板选中一个可用乐器行，底部显示“目标轨：<轨名>”，装载按钮可用，结果行显示“仅登记”提示。
en_caption: The panel has a usable instrument row selected; the bottom shows "Target track: <name>", the load button is enabled, and the result line shows the "registration only" note.
zh_steps: 选中可用乐器行，点“装载到当前轨”，确认结果行出现“仅登记：实时播放不执行该插件；离线导出与整曲预览执行首台已装载的插件”。
en_steps: Select a usable instrument row, click "Load to current track", and confirm the result line shows "Registration only: real-time playback does not execute this plugin; offline export and full-song preview execute the first loaded plugin".

name: plugin-panel-scan
zh_caption: “插件与 ARA”面板打开，左侧 VST3 列表显示类名、厂商、乐器/效果器、可用/失败状态与路径。
en_caption: The "Plugins and ARA" panel is open; the left VST3 list shows class, vendor, instrument/effect, usable/failed state, and path.
zh_steps: 选中一条 MIDI 轨，点设备机架“插件”按钮，在额外扫描目录留空或填一个目录，点“扫描”，确认失败行以红色留在列表里。
en_steps: Select a MIDI track, click the device rack's "Plugins" button, leave the extra scan dirs empty or fill one, click "Scan", and confirm failed rows stay red in the list.
